fields.Name: Integration Test: Own Rows by UserID
fields.Description: Integration-test-only Row-Level-Security filter: scopes a read to rows whose UserID is the caller's own. Bound by the 'Integration Test: RLS Mixed Filtered' role to 'MJ: User Roles', where every user owns at least one row, so the rls-isolation checks RLS12/RLS13 can compare the narrowed row set with the full one on any database. Safe to delete together with that role.
